note: v3 redeploy 2026-10-01 (commit e49aae5): two books (USDG, USDC), each a first-loss vault (30%) and a senior vault (70%); Thursday 19:30 UTC bind deadline; maxPremium on bind; void proofs. The Stylus Pricer is the 2026-09-28 deploy, reused unchanged.

Treaty.role: bind(book, exposure, retention, limit, maxPremium), setReference, voidReference, fix, voidFix, cancel, claim

Capacity.role: four ERC-4626 vaults deployed by the Treaty constructor, one first-loss and one senior vault per book

Pricer.size: 25,765 bytes compressed, 2 fragments behind a 48-byte root

verification.reason: Sourcify's Solidity route does not take Stylus/WASM bytecode; cargo stylus verify needs a reproducible Docker build, and no Docker daemon was available for this deploy.

PricerSixTables.role: on-chain premium (Rust/Stylus) with six scenario tables: ids [0 NVDA, 1 AAPL, 2 SPY, 3 TSLA, 4 EUR/USD, 5 XAU/USD]; equity tables in whole bps, EUR/USD and XAU/USD in hundredths of a bp. Priced by the /quote page; the Treaty keeps the Pricer above.

verification.reason: Sourcify's Solidity route does not take Stylus/WASM bytecode; cargo stylus verify needs a reproducible Docker build, and no Docker daemon was available for this deploy.

PricerSolidityTwin.role: Solidity twin of the pricer, deployed only for the gas comparison in docs/pricing.md; Treaty does not use it

OIGuard.role: open-interest guard for a perp LP vault: check(book, market, size) prices weekend cover on the resulting book with PricerSixTables and reverts PremiumOverBudget(premium, budget, currentPremium) above the owner budget; premium-lowering trades pass

constructorArgs.SEQUENCER_FEED_NOTE: Arbitrum Sepolia has no L2 Sequencer Uptime Status Feed; address(0) disables the check on this deploy only. A mainnet deploy must pass 0xFdB631F5EE196F0ed6FAa767959853A9F217697D.
